description: This file defines custom WPF/UWP controls related to supplementary items in a calculator app, including SupplementaryItemsControl, SupplementaryContentPresenter, and automation peer classes for accessibility.

classes.name: SupplementaryItemsControl
classes.description: A custom ItemsControl that creates SupplementaryContentPresenter containers and sets automation properties for items.

classes.name: SupplementaryContentPresenter
classes.description: A ContentPresenter that creates an automation peer for accessibility.

classes.name: SupplementaryContentPresenterAP
classes.description: An automation peer class providing accessibility information for SupplementaryContentPresenter.

methods.name: GetContainerForItemOverride
methods.description: Creates and returns a new SupplementaryContentPresenter for each item.

methods.name: PrepareContainerForItemOverride
methods.description: Prepares the container for an item, setting automation properties if the item is a SupplementaryResult.

methods.name: OnCreateAutomationPeer
methods.description: Creates an automation peer for the SupplementaryContentPresenter.

methods.name: GetAutomationControlTypeCore
methods.description: Returns the control type for automation, which is Text.

methods.name: GetChildrenCore
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no child automation peers.

methods.name: SupplementaryContentPresenterAP
methods.description: Constructor for the automation peer, associating it with its owner.
